# OCEL v2 RevOps hyperdimensional control graph

Project #2 is the canonical object-centric economic/process memory for the five-cell manufacturing system. This record is intentionally dense: events are never reduced to one case id when they relate to multiple economic, software, human, repository, capability, and revenue objects. Case-centric/XES/CSV views are projections only.

## OCEL v2 truth surface

Represent object types, event types, event-object relations, object-object relations, qualifiers, dynamic attributes, timelines, provenance, standing, authority, receipts, and value attribution. Every material observation/manufacture/qualification/value event SHOULD connect every known relevant object rather than copying the event into multiple siloed cards.

### Core object types

- Repository — GitHub repository and exact default/head lineage.
- Commit — immutable manufactured semantic transition/production unit.
- PullRequest — integration/qualification/merge boundary.
- Capability — reusable technical/economic capability.
- Primitive — canonical ontology/pack/generator/court/factory/meta-factory source.
- Consumer — repository/runtime/API/CLI/package/human/system consuming a capability.
- Human — operator, customer, prospect, partner, developer, seller, buyer, beneficiary.
- Organization — account/customer/partner/employer/business receiving or paying for value.
- Product — packaged capability or composed product surface.
- Offer — commercial/service/package proposition.
- Opportunity — revenue or value-capture possibility.
- RevenueStream — recurring, usage, license, service, implementation, support, marketplace, savings-to-margin, or customer-generated-revenue stream.
- Contract — commercial agreement/bounded authority object.
- Invoice — receivable object.
- Payment — realized cash/revenue evidence object.
- ValueOutcome — measurable outcome created for a human/organization.
- CustomerRevenueOutcome — revenue the system helps a customer generate, expand, retain, or accelerate.
- DistributionSurface — package registry, API, CLI, UI, integration, documentation, marketplace, channel, deployment/reference architecture.
- UI — Ash/Elixir human interaction surface.
- AshResource — canonical domain/resource model.
- AshAction — authorized query/create/update/destroy/action/calculation boundary.
- Process — discovered/designed revenue/manufacturing process.
- Evidence — observed proof, benchmark, receipt, qualification, experiment, process trace.
- Memory — Project #2 durable state/key.
- ScheduleRun — one MEASURE/EXPLORE/SELECT/IMPLEMENT/PORTFOLIO execution.
- Falsifier — typed condition that invalidates a claim/path.

### Core event types

- repository.observed
- capability.discovered
- capability.composed
- capability.selected
- capability.manufactured
- capability.qualified
- capability.replicated
- commit.created
- pr.created
- pr.qualified
- pr.merged
- primitive.created
- primitive.reused
- consumer.discovered
- consumer.qualified
- distribution.created
- ui.exposed
- human.interacted
- value.hypothesized
- value.proved
- opportunity.discovered
- offer.composed
- revenue.capacity_created
- revenue.attributed
- revenue.realized
- customer_revenue.capacity_created
- customer_revenue.attributed
- customer_revenue.realized
- invoice.created
- payment.received
- retention.signal_observed
- expansion.opportunity_discovered
- renewal.opportunity_discovered
- schedule.started
- schedule.completed
- memory.read
- memory.updated
- falsifier.triggered
- authority.refused

### Relation qualifiers

Use explicit qualifiers rather than generic links: manufactured_by, source_of, generated_from, qualifies, consumes, unlocks, composes_with, depends_on, supersedes, observed_in, evidenced_by, offered_to, paid_by, benefits, generates_revenue_for, generates_revenue_from, attributed_to, distributed_through, interacted_through, implemented_by, exposed_by, authorized_by, falsified_by, remembered_by, caused, enabled, retained_by, expanded_by.

### Dynamic attributes

Track time-varying attributes as event-bound/object changes: standing; head_sha; semantic_commit_count; commits_per_hour; consumer_count; qualified_consumer_count; E; E2; Y; R; Q; C; M; V; expected_value; realized_revenue; customer_generated_revenue; pipeline_value; conversion_evidence; distribution_readiness; qualification_strength; evidence_strength; authority_state; currentness; supersession; replay_receipt.

## Dual RevOps objective

The economic graph must model two simultaneous flows:

1. **Revenue FROM users/customers** — capability -> product/offer -> organization/human -> contract/invoice/payment -> realized revenue -> reinvestment.
2. **Revenue FOR users/customers** — capability -> human/Ash UI interaction -> customer process -> value outcome -> customer revenue capacity -> customer realized revenue/retention/expansion -> proof -> stronger offer/adoption.

Never collapse these flows into one revenue field. Preserve payer, beneficiary, revenue producer, causal capability, evidence, amount/currency when observed, time window, and attribution confidence as separate dimensions.

## Ash/Elixir human interaction projection

Manufacture an Elixir/Ash application surface over this graph so humans can interact with the same canonical objects instead of a separate CRM truth. Ash Resources should project OCEL objects and relations; Ash Actions should express bounded transitions; Reactor should orchestrate multi-hop revenue/value workflows; Phoenix/LiveView/Ash-oriented UI surfaces should expose role-appropriate views.

Required human lenses:

- **Make us revenue**: opportunity graph, offers, package/distribution readiness, value proof, pipeline/value attribution, invoice/payment evidence, retention/expansion surfaces, next revenue-generating actions.
- **Help them make revenue**: customer goals, current process, capability-to-outcome map, recommended compositions, simulations/experiments, generated assets/integrations, measurable customer revenue outcomes, causal proof, next expansion opportunities.
- **Manufacturing telemetry**: commit throughput, schedules, repositories, primitives, consumer fanout, qualification, value/revenue capacity created per manufacturing cycle.
- **Object-centric process intelligence**: choose any Repository, Capability, Consumer, Human, Organization, Product, Offer, Opportunity, RevenueStream, or ValueOutcome and traverse its complete event/object neighborhood and timeline.

The UI is a projection of the OCEL v2 truth surface, never an independent database of business truth.

## Hyperdimensional information-density law

Maximize useful relations and dimensions per canonical memory object rather than card count. One event should retain all valid object relations, qualifiers, temporal changes, evidence roots, standing, authority, economic attribution, manufacturing lineage, and process context. Prefer graph density and traversability over duplicate prose. Project memory stores current object/process/economic state and durable learned topology; Git commits remain immutable manufacturing receipts.

Measure density as a vector, not one scalar: object types/event, qualified relations/event, independently rooted evidence/event, temporal attributes/object, cross-repo edges, consumer edges, economic/value edges, causal edges, replayable receipts, and actionable adjacencies created per memory read. A Project-memory mutation is valuable when it causes more lawful manufacturing/revenue opportunities to become reachable.

## Five-cell use

MEASURE emits observations/value signals as OCEL events. EXPLORE emits candidate/composition/value-hypothesis events. SELECT/DEVELOP emits capital-allocation and productization events. IMPLEMENT/QUALIFY emits manufacture/replication/qualification/value-proof events. PORTFOLIO emits merge, attribution, revenue-capacity, reinvestment, supersession, and next-frontier events. All five cells read and update this same object-centric graph through the bounded project-memory-bus.

## Standing and evidence

Preserve UNKNOWN | PARTIAL_ALIVE | ALIVE | BUILD_BROKEN | UNSUPPORTED | typed REFUSED. Distinguish observed revenue, qualified revenue capacity, bounded-inferred revenue opportunity, customer-generated revenue evidence, and unsupported claims. Zero unreceipted consequential actuation.

metadata.objective: maximize commit manufacturing throughput, hyperdimensional information density, portfolio revenue, and customer revenue generation
